title: NVIDIA opens applications for 2027-2028 graduate fellowship program
excerpt: The program offers grants of up to $60,000 to doctoral students conducting research in fields including artificial intelligence and robotics.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on September 30, 2026, that it is accepting applications for its Graduate Fellowship Program for the 2027-2028 academic year. The program provides grants, mentors, and technical support to doctoral students performing research relevant to NVIDIA technologies. Since its start in 2002, the Graduate Fellowship Program has awarded over 220 grants worth around $8 million.

Eligible candidates must have completed at least their first year of Ph.D.-level studies at the time of application. The program supports research in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, autonomous vehicles, computer graphics, robotics, healthcare, and high-performance computing. Awards are up to $60,000 per student.

Applicants are required to participate in an in-person internship at an NVIDIA research office during the summer of 2027. This internship must precede the fellowship year. The deadline to submit applications for the 2027-2028 academic year is October 30, 2026.
